en: Assertion of the Strength of Virtue

kurals.tr: Sirappu Eenum Selvamum Eenum / Araththinooungu Aakkam Evano Uyirkku
kurals.m: Virtue will confer heaven and wealth; what greater source of happiness can man possess ?

kurals.tr: Araththinooungu Aakkamum Illai Adhanai / Maraththalin Oongillai Ketu
kurals.m: There can be no greater source of good than (the practice of) virtue; there can be no greater source of evil than the forgetfulness of it

kurals.tr: Ollum Vakaiyaan Aravinai Ovaadhe / Sellumvaai Ellaanj Cheyal
kurals.m: As much as possible, in every way, incessantly practise virtue

kurals.tr: Manaththukkan Maasilan Aadhal Anaiththu / Aran Aakula Neera Pira
kurals.m: Let him who does virtuous deeds be of spotless mind; to that extent is virtue; all else is vain show

kurals.tr: Azhukkaaru Avaavekuli Innaachchol Naankum / Izhukkaa Iyandradhu Aram
kurals.m: That conduct is virtue which is free from these four things, viz, malice, desire, anger and bitter speech

kurals.tr: Andrarivaam Ennaadhu Aranjeyka Matradhu / Pondrungaal Pondraath Thunai
kurals.m: Defer not virtue to another day; receive her now; and at the dying hour she will be your undying friend

kurals.tr: Araththaaru Ithuvena Ventaa Sivikai / Poruththaanotu Oorndhaan Itai
kurals.m: The fruit of virtue need not be described in books; it may be inferred from seeing the bearer of a palanquin and the rider therein

kurals.tr: Veezhnaal Pataaamai Nandraatrin Aqdhoruvan / Vaazhnaal Vazhiyataikkum Kal
kurals.m: If one allows no day to pass without some good being done, his conduct will be a stone to block up the passage to other births

kurals.tr: Araththaan Varuvadhe Inpam Mar / Rellaam Puraththa Pukazhum Ila
kurals.m: Only that pleasure which flows from domestic virtue is pleasure; all else is not pleasure, and it is without praise

kurals.tr: Seyarpaala Thorum Arane Oruvarku / Uyarpaala Thorum Pazhi
kurals.m: That is virtue which each ought to do, and that is vice which each should shun
